verdict.rationale: Marketing pages for the service (LegalZoom Virtual Mail, which Earth Class Mail is now part of) state that mail is opened and scanned in operated facilities with access controls, protected with 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication, and that secure shredding is included. These are brief claims rather than detailed security documentation, and staff screening is not mentioned. Missing for 10: staff background screening, detailed facility security documentation, explicit encryption-at-rest/in-transit details for scans, compliance attestations or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, the provider documents how mail is physically secured and digitally protected — facility controls, staff screening, encryption of scans

citations.quote: opening and scanning completed in facilities we operate with access controls
Keep your business mail secure with multi-layered protection, including 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication.
